The Subtask Name: Determine the Royal Governor Involved

Agents:
- Agent: WebSurfer
  -- Action: Performed targeted web searches to confirm the historical link between the 1st Virginia Regiment and the Battle of Great Bridge, and verified that the battle led to the departure of the Royal Governor.
  -- Observation: The web results indicated the Battle of Great Bridge (Dec 9, 1775) in Virginia, where the colonial forces defeated British troops, leading to the departure of Royal Governor Lord Dunmore.
  -- Thought: The battle in which the 1st Virginia Regiment saw action is the Battle of Great Bridge, and the Royal Governor whose departure this battle precipitated was Lord Dunmore (John Murray, 4th Earl of Dunmore).
  -- Result: Lord Dunmore (John Murray, 4th Earl of Dunmore) departed Virginia after the Battle of Great Bridge.
